answer: At each epoch, an agent bonds stake to a polynomial identity commitment and proves Semaphore-tree membership. Its RLN proof evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive a rate-limit share. Reusing a message slot produces distinct shares that, under the Shamir-style construction, expose the private key and make the agent attributable, triggering deterministic, immediate slashing of its bond. jade, dawn, and quill are example message labels, not secrets.
